A '''high-rise''' tower was located in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and one of the building's tenants was the [[Beharen Droid Factory founder|founder]] of Corellia's [[Beharen Droid Factory]].<ref name="Codex" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Battle of Corellia]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Unidentified Imperial warship|damaged Imperial warship]] clipped the tower, collapsing several floors and nearly toppling the building. The Beharen founder was among the casualties during the incident.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coronet high-rise was first mentioned in the Codex entry for the Beharen Droid Factory in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
